items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Johnny Bajon was playing the band... He was playing with the best man, Johnny Bajon... I don't know that. He was playing with the band... I don't know what happened to him.

ctx.x: Edgewater is where the rich people go and Broadwater is more fun place.

Oh, but the one you're talking about, the big hotel years ago, when I was playing in Biloxi, I was playing with, I believe, with Alex Spatic of the Trauma. I played in some way. And Johnny Quattusi, he was a collected dues for the union for 174 in Biloxi. At that time they had the name bands in this hotel here. And Johnny Bajon was playing the band. See Johnny? Nobody gives a guy any credit. He was playing with the best man, Johnny Bajon. I don't know that. He was playing with the band, Joe Lief was playing. Big…
What about Joe Boycannon? Oh, well I see.
